caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair positioned at a three-quarter angle, showing both the side and partial front view. The chair has a tall, curved back with an ornate central splat, and the wood is depicted in shades of brown with visible grain. The seat of the chair is upholstered with a patterned fabric featuring a floral design in muted greens, reds, blues, and beige tones. The legs are slightly cabriole, and the chair is reinforced with horizontal stretchers connecting the legs. The background is plain, untextured, and beige, with no other objects or elements present in the composition. The artist's signature “Harry Eisman” is located in the lower right corner.
title: Side Chair
